observed_need: PISA: 18% of represented 15-year-old students reached mathematics Level 2 or higher; almost none reached Levels 5-6
evidence_scope: 13,439 students in 410 schools; 85% of the total age cohort represented
known_supply: Established Indonesian mathematics program; Open Logic is complete at 722/722. At the pinned public boundary, 27/40 roles are published and 13/40 are in production. The central ledger records 19,745 teaching-package pages, 20,763 selected-corpus working pages, and a 27,705-page rendered universe; final Indonesian pagination is unknown.
binding_marginal_gap: No Open Logic translation-completion gap remains. Any further intervention must address a catalog-proven content, accessibility, offline-delivery, diagnostic, QA, maintenance, or advanced-topic gap without duplicating the current program.
first_useful_open_package: No content package preselected: use the verified 27-published/13-production catalog to commission only an exact remaining course or format gap.
follow_on_package: Commission only a specifically demonstrated missing package or accessibility/maintenance intervention.
openstax_openlogic_mapping: Open Logic is already 722/722; map OpenStax or other sources only to a demonstrated missing curriculum function after catalog reconciliation.
delivery_spec: Retain and improve verified offline HTML/EPUB + screen/print PDF + complete answers/worked error explanations + Indonesian academic-language glossary only where the audit finds a practical-access or quality gap
caveat: BPS 248,501,794 is an age-5+ spoken/understood-language criterion, not written or academic proficiency. Page universes are not interchangeable: 19,745 teaching-package, 20,763 selected-corpus working, 27,705 rendered-universe, and 26,031 public-artifact reconstruction pages are not a final translated-page total.
